L130: A file added to the composer becomes a chip: an icon for its kind, its name and size, and a trailing slot that carries a spinner while it uploads and a remove button once it is done. With a runtime the chip tracks a real upload through an attachment adapter; standalone you hold the list of files and their state yourself. L131: ## 【177†Getting started】 L132: L133: A composer stages files the same way it stages text: `aui.composer.addAttachment(file)` adds one, an `AttachmentAdapter` turns it into a `PendingAttachment` and then a `CompleteAttachment`, and `s.composer.attachments` reflects the list at every step.
